title: Virginia Switzer:
headline: New shoes tell a child: we see you, you fit, we care. A volunteer leader who “didn't get it until I got it”.
story: Virginia Switzer is one of the co-chairs of the Soles4Souls Twin Cities initiative. She admits it sounds a little corny: she didn't really get it until she got it. Cool new shoes tell a kid that someone cares about them.

She felt called to serve, and it was an easy yes. Now the goal is every one of the 10,000 kids in the Twin Cities, year after year. Her last line is the invitation: if you feel it in your heart, let your feet follow. Warm and hopeful.
